title: Matched Specialization, Different Adaptation: Second-Moment Structure in Shared Representations
abstract: arXiv:2610.15830v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Small Adam-trained shared-representation networks can reach equivalent selected mean readout measurements yet respond differently to the same further learning. We use state interventions to separate second-moment scale and coordinate-pattern effects, then examine their formation and time dependence. In the central two-target experiment, the more precisely readable target switches within ten updates in 67.5% of acquisition-formed checkpoints and 0% of update-formed checkpoints. First-moment exchange leaves the ten-update contrast change within its pre-specified margin, whereas second-moment exchange reverses the contrast. A coordinate-pattern effect remains at common mean adaptive scale. Layer and movement controls locate an effect beyond overall update size. Formation records connect small encoder second moments with stronger cancellation between task gradients. A prospective gradient-projection experiment changes this retained state

translated_title: 匹配的专门化，不同的适应：共享表征中的二阶矩结构
translated_abstract: 小型Adam训练的共享表征网络可以达到等效的选定平均读出测量值，却对相同的后续学习表现出不同的响应。我们使用状态干预来分离二阶矩尺度和坐标模式效应，然后检验它们的形成和时间依赖性。在核心的双目标实验中，在67.5%的获取形成检查点和0%的更新形成检查点中，更精确可读的目标在十次更新内发生切换。一阶矩交换使十次更新的对比变化保持在其预设范围内，而二阶矩交换则逆转了对比。坐标模式效应在共同的平均自适应尺度上仍然存在。层级和移动控制将该效应定位在整体更新规模之外。形成记录将小的编码器二阶矩与任务梯度之间更强的抵消联系起来。一项前瞻性的梯度投影实验改变了这种保留状态。
tldr: 该论文通过状态干预发现，达到相同平均读出测量值的Adam训练共享表征网络因二阶矩坐标模式结构的不同而对后续学习产生截然不同的响应，揭示了专门化程度匹配但适应能力却不同的隐藏机制。
en_tdlr: Through state interventions, this paper reveals that Adam-trained shared-representation networks with equivalent mean readout measurements respond differently to further learning due to distinct second-moment coordinate-pattern structures, uncovering hidden mechanisms where specialization is matched but adaptation differs.
